name: vETH
fix_description: Function 0x6c0472da uses pair.getReserves() to calculate swap output amount at spot price. Attacker flash-loans to manipulate pair reserves, then calls this function to receive disproportionate output at the manipulated price. Fix by using TWAP oracle instead of instant reserves, or add a price deviation check against a reference oracle.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC itself is short, but the exploit requires understanding a protocol-specific factory flaw plus a flash-loan-funded buy/exploit/sell sequence across Balancer, a custom DEX interface, and the vulnerable contract. It is not just an obvious access-control bug, but also not a deeply complex multi-transaction or cross-protocol accounting attack.
